youtube.title: Option Khareeda, Market Upar Gaya, Phir Bhi Loss? Theta Samjho #Shorts
youtube.description:
Option buyers zyaadatar loss kyun karte hain, jab market unki side bhi jaata hai? Ek badi wajah: time decay (theta). Option premium ek ice cream ki tarah har din thoda pighalta hai.
ऑप्शन का प्रीमियम हर दिन थोड़ा पिघलता है।

Is video ke numbers (SEBI study, Aug 2026):
• FY 2025-26 mein kareeb 87.7% individual F&O traders ko net loss hua
• Individual traders ke total loss ka kareeb 92% options se aaya

Kabhi direction sahi hone ke baad bhi option mein loss hua hai? Comment karo 👇
